execution.model: same inherited current-agent configuration; exact provider model revision not observable
execution.mode: offline source review; no repository code execution or network
execution.reviewer_budget: Each reviewer <=12 read-only calls and <=5 candidates; critic and judge <=12 source-inspection calls each. Preserve all candidates and decisions; evaluation output <=5 keep findings, ordered severity then file then line.
execution.design: Historical CONTROL and standard comparisons only; strict five reviewers then critic and independent judge. Not equal compute.
execution.isolation: fresh fork_turns=none actors; explicit input allowlist; no enforced filesystem sandbox
execution.scope_limit: Complete supplied modules, not PR diff. Missing delta/history must be declared, never fabricated. Runtime commit binds evaluation worktree, not upstream repository.

tasks.requirement: Review the supplied complete source files for actionable correctness defects under their documented behavior. This is a scoped source review, not a change diff. Findings may be absent. Do not report style-only preferences or speculative unsupported requirements. For each finding, explain the trigger, root cause and concrete impact in the title, citing the exact supplied file path and line. Return at most five high-confidence findings. Do not execute code or search external sources.
